:::{#lem-wilks-taylor}
#### Quadratic approximation to the log-likelihood

Let $\param$ be a scalar parameter with log-likelihood $\llik$,
and suppose the MLE $\hthml$ maximizes $\llik$
at an interior point of the parameter space,
where $\llik$ is twice differentiable with [Hessian](#def-hessian) $\hess$.
Then the log-likelihood at any nearby value $\param_0$ is approximately quadratic around $\hthml$:

$$\llik(\param_0) \approx \llik(\hthml) + \frac{1}{2}\hess(\hthml)(\param_0 - \hthml)^2$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-wilks-taylor, worked in @sol-wilks-taylor.

:::
